Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, with experience communicating effectively with executives and stakeholders at all organizational levels.

The Consultant is responsible for leading organizational consulting engagements that advance the strategic priorities of UC Davis Health through the application of organizational consulting, strategic planning, portfolio, program and/or project management, process improvement, organizational effectiveness, and change management. The Consultant independently leads departmental, divisional, and cross-functional consulting engagements and, based on organizational need and demonstrated capability, may also lead or contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives within an established scope, sponsorship structure, and governance model. The Consultant applies project management methodologies, Lean, Six Sigma, and change management practices to assess organizational challenges, identify opportunities, implement sustainable solutions, and achieve measurable business outcomes. The Consultant exercises independent judgment in managing assigned engagements and escalates significant strategic, governance, resource, or implementation risks when appropriate.
85% - Process Improvement and/or Portfolio, Program and/or Project Management
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting established deadlines.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess business challenges, identify root causes, and develop sustainable solutions.
Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships.
